## 1. Professional Overview & Positioning
Sourabh Awasekar is an Applied AI & Product Systems Engineer with over 5 years of production experience bridging the gap between raw data lakes, enterprise warehouses, LLM harnesses, and polished user-facing software. 

His engineering philosophy is rooted in physical process dynamics from BITS Pilani: systems should operate with minimal friction, maximum throughput, and low unit economics. Rather than building ephemeral LLM wrappers, Sourabh focuses on:
1. Grounded AI systems (Text-to-SQL governed by centralized semantic layers and custom Model Context Protocol / MCP servers)
2. Rigorous cost and inference efficiency (<$100 per 15k sessions, client-side ML via Web Audio and ONNX)
3. Full-stack operational resilience (from Redshift node pruning and automated scrapers to C++17 DSP desktop binaries)

## 2. Production Systems & Shipped Products

### 2.1 amber Ocean (Flagship Agentic AI Analytics Harness)
- Category: Agentic AI Analytics / Text-to-SQL / Enterprise BI
- Role: Architect & Lead Builder at amber (amberstudent.com)
- Problem: Operational, product, and leadership teams faced turnaround delays for ad-hoc analytical queries and root-cause analyses, bottlenecking data analysts.
- Architectural Solution:
  - Designed an agentic AI analytics harness integrating a centralized Semantic Layer that standardizes metrics across tools.
  - Implemented custom Model Context Protocol (MCP) server over AWS Redshift with schema guardrails and query validation.
  - Utilized multi-model routing (Claude, OpenAI) and agent skills answering business questions with SQL, charts, and RCAs.
- Verified Metrics:
  - Total compute cost under $100 per 15,000 user sessions (<$0.01 per session)
  - 3,000+ production queries processed with ~$30 in total compute overhead
  - Over 80% reduction in ad-hoc SQL support requests across departments

### 2.2 amber Radar (Commercial B2B Market Intelligence)
- Category: Predictive Machine Learning / Commercial SaaS
- Role: Product & ML Lead at amber (radar.amberstudent.com)
- Problem: UK PBSA (Purpose-Built Student Accommodation) operators and institutional investors lacked dynamic visibility into localized student demand, real-time supply availability, and competitive pricing across university markets.
- Architectural Solution:
  - Engineered automated daily ELT scraper pipelines aggregating listings, rates, and occupancy across university markets.
  - Developed predictive demand models using Scikit-Learn and Python statistical routines.
  - Delivered insights via an interactive, high-performance Next.js commercial web application.
- Verified Metrics:
  - Generated $30k ARR licensed by 50+ UK property management groups and institutional investors.
  - Accelerated market research turnaround from several weeks of manual collation to sub-minute interactive dashboards.

### 2.3 amber Prism (LLM Transcript Platform & Operations Intelligence)
- Category: LLM Systems / Operations Intelligence / NLP
- Role: Architect & Lead Builder at amber
- Problem: Manual QA sampling covered only 30% of customer interactions, leaving critical quality blindspots and undetected lead churn in high-velocity sales pipelines.
- Architectural Solution:
  - Automated ingestion of omni-channel customer communication transcripts (calls, WhatsApp, email, SMS).
  - Structured extraction of objection themes, sales quality scoring, and deal-risk indicators using LLM prompt chaining and vector classification.
  - Integrated real-time alert webhooks that instantly notify sales managers and leadership of at-risk deals.
- Verified Metrics:
  - Adopted by 100+ daily active users across Sales, Ops, and Leadership.
  - Lifted quality audit coverage from 30% (manual sampling) to 90%.
  - Real-time deal-risk notifications dispatched directly to CRM and team communication channels.

### 2.4 plectrum.live & PlectrumLabs (Audio Systems & Web Platform)
- Category: Audio Engineering / Web ML / Native C++ DSP Software
- Role: Founder & Systems Engineer
- Problem: Music creators face steep subscription fees and cloud latency for essential audio tools such as audio mastering, stem separation, and pitch analysis.
- Architectural Solution:
  - Web Architecture (plectrum.live): 18+ browser audio tools executing 100% client-side using Web Audio API, TensorFlow.js, and ONNX Runtime Web ($0 server-side compute cost).
  - Desktop Architecture (PlectrumLabs): Suite of 5 native C++17 and JUCE 8 desktop audio applications and VST3/AU audio plugins, including PluckMaster (7-stage mastering chain), PluckBoard (real-time pitch visualization), and PluckStem (neural stem separation).
- Verified Metrics:
  - Sub-millisecond latency local DSP on macOS and Windows platforms.
  - Universal binary distribution with notarized macOS disk images (.dmg) and Audio Units / VST3 formats.

### 2.5 5X Data Platform
- Category: Enterprise SaaS / Data Infrastructure / Usage Billing
- Role: Associate Product Manager at 5X Data (5x.co)
- Delivered:
  - In-house usage billing system that eliminated third-party billing costs, saving $2,000/month.
  - Enterprise identity & access management (IAM) solutions, driving $10,000/month in added contract value.
  - API-first data engineering SaaS generating $20,000/month in new enterprise revenue.
  - 50% accuracy improvement on customer utilization forecasting models.

### 2.6 Junglee Games Analytics Suite
- Category: Real-Money Gaming / GTM Launch & Microservices
- Role: Product Analyst at Junglee Games (jungleegames.com)
- Delivered:
  - End-to-end GTM onboarding funnels for Poker launch, driving ₹1.2 lakh daily revenue within 18 days (~5% daily growth).
  - Goal-based reward microservice yielding +20% weekly player reactivation and +10% lift in 30-day retention.
  - Real-time anomaly detection alerts for double-spends and transactional failure.

### 2.7 Turing Enterprise AI / RLHF
- Category: Model Alignment / Evaluation Benchmarking
- Role: Lead Business Analyst at Turing (turing.com)
- Delivered:
  - 100+ multimodal prompt evaluations and RLHF annotations contributing to the public MMMU benchmark.
  - AI-vs-human content classifiers to mitigate automated plagiarism in technical tasks.
  - Automated NLP feedback categorization using spaCy and NLTK.

### 2.8 Crimson AI / Trinka AI
- Category: Academic NLP & Desktop Add-ins
- Role: Associate Product Manager at Crimson AI (trinka.ai)
- Delivered:
  - Reduced Trinka AI Microsoft Word Add-in load latency by 40% through LiteDB query tuning and grammar card grouping.
  - Led discovery and developer handoff for Enago Reports web platform in under 1 month.

### 2.9 HISP India COVID-19 Surveillance
- Category: Public Health Geospatial Data
- Role: Software Developer at HISP India
- Delivered:
  - Geospatial resource mapping and facility geo-tagging for national crisis monitoring.
  - Data wrangling and deduplication across public health streams, improving app performance by 25%.
